description.plain_text: PointCloudGenerator The input image sequence is tracked to generate a dense 3D point cloud. The analysis must be performed in NukeX but the result can be used in Nuke. Use 'Analyze Sequence' to automatically choose a set of keyframes for point cloud generation. Keyframes are selected with good overlap for tracking and with a sufficient camera baseline to triangulate 3D points. The accuracy of each keyframe is calculated so that you can choose frame ranges where the 'Calculated Accuracy' is highest to produce a more accurate point cloud. Use 'Track Points' to track points in the keyframes and generate the point cloud. Keyframes can be set manually. As a general rule, choose frames that have more than 80% overlap and where the camera motion between frames produces a triangulation angle greater than 1 degree. The point cloud can be labelled as groups under the 'Groups' tab and groups can be baked out or converted to a mesh.
